title: Ojciec prowadzący działalność po martwym urodzeniu dziecka: zasiłek macierzyński za 9 tygodni urlopu macierzyńskiego
extractionNotes: Self-employed father (Z-3b filled as his own payer); no ZUS register printout, so the insurance start is unknown: titles[0].from is a placeholder equal to the claim start (he was paid, so he was insured then), not a real start date. Child stillborn (registry extract with the stillbirth annotation); birth date redacted, so event.occurred is set and mode is adjudication. ZAM: maternity-leave box only, 81.5% box not ticked, birth ticked as reason; the mother's data filled in but no reason box (resignation, hospital, incapacity, work, abandonment, death) visibly ticked. Requested 2024-08-23 to a handwritten end in late October (read as 24.10.2024, i.e. 63 days = 9 weeks; uncertain). ZUS note: entitlement established and benefit paid. Application date not legible; asOf set to the claim start.
